{{Quote|Their armor&mdash;it's like a ''liquid metal''&hellip; ''leaving'' them&hellip;''"<br />"''Get ''away'' from it, Anakin, before&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;and flowing over&mdash;''No''!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Mask of Iron" />}}
'''Blayne's liquid metal''' was a blue liquid that latched onto hosts and took control of their actions, making them one of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Blayne]]'s [[Blayne's droid|droids]]. The metal liquid, serving as an [[Armor/Legends|armor]], left its wearer once it could no longer read vital signs. It would then try to find another host to latch onto.
